title: Kenya C&I Solar Case Study: 64kWh Dawnice Battery & 50kW Deye Inverter (March 2026)
summary: A 64kWh rack-mounted battery with a 50kW Deye inverter for a Kenyan commercial site.
challenge: Kenyan businesses face high peak-time tariffs and occasional grid instability that stops production mid-shift.
solution: A 64kWh rack-mounted LiFePO4 battery with a 50kW Deye inverter, using the rack format for airflow and cooling.
result: The modular rack keeps capacity expandable while maintaining airflow around the modules.
